pages.title: Guanaco
pages.text: The guanaco ($(o)Lama guanicoe$()) is a wild camelid native to South America, found from the Andes of Peru to the plains of Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego.$(br2)It is the wild ancestor of the domestic llama.$(br2)Guanacos usually live in family groups of a single male with several females and their young. Their thick, woolly coat protects them in cold, dry and high-altitude habitats.
